module: Flowgraph node "Start Cam Path" (once_instant). Makes the camera follow the path of a CameraPath object (.camPath.json file). Inputs: pathName (string), loop (bool). Outputs: activated (flow impulse, a single frame) and id (number) of the path. Uses the flowgraph camera module (self.mgr.modules.camera).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

postInit.desc: Restricts the pathName pin to the "Camera Path Files" file selector (.camPath.json).

workOnce.desc: Finds the path (modules.camera:findPath), starts it (startPath with loop), writes id and raises the activated impulse.

work.desc: Drops activated back to false on the frame following the activation (flag activatedFlag).

drawMiddle.desc: Central area of the node (nothing displayed).
